sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER'S FAVORITE TV SHOWS ARE AND WHY.  ARE YOUR INTERESTS SIMILAR OR DIFFERENT?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hey, so what's your favorite TV show?
ParticipantB: Um, I don't really have one.
ParticipantA: Oh, that's okay. I'm kind of the same way. But if you had to pick one, what would it be?
ParticipantB: I don't know, maybe "Friends" or something.
ParticipantA: "Friends" is a good one. I like that show too.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it's just so relatable.
ParticipantA: Definitely. I think that's why it's so popular.
ParticipantB: What about you? Do you have a favorite show?
ParticipantA: Well, I used to like "The Office" a lot.
ParticipantB: Oh, I love that show!
ParticipantA: Yeah, it's pretty funny. Have you seen the American version or the British one?
ParticipantB: The American one, of course.
ParticipantA: Yeah, it's definitely one of my favorites.
ParticipantB: So, what made you like it so much?
ParticipantA: I just think it's really well written and the characters are all really interesting.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I agree. I especially love Jim and Pam.
ParticipantA: Oh, me too. Their relationship is so cute.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it's just the best.
ParticipantA: So, what do you think makes a good TV show?
ParticipantB: I think it just has to be relatable and have good writing.
ParticipantA: Definitely. And I think it's important for the characters to be likable too.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I agree. I can't stand shows where the characters are just annoying.
ParticipantA: Exactly. And I think it's also important for the show to have a clear concept or message.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I agree. I think that's why I like "Friends" so much. It's just about friendship and relationships.
ParticipantA: Yeah, it's a pretty simple concept, but it's executed really well.
ParticipantB: So, what do you think is the best TV show of all time?
ParticipantA: Oh, that's tough. I don't know if I can pick just one.
ParticipantB: Yeah, there are so many good ones.
ParticipantA: I think "Breaking Bad" is up there for me.
ParticipantB: Oh, I've heard that's really good. Have you seen it?
ParticipantA: Yeah, I have. It's definitely one of the best shows I've ever seen.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I've been meaning to watch it. Maybe I'll have to check it out.
ParticipantA: Definitely. It's worth the watch.
ParticipantB: Cool, I'll have to check it out.
ParticipantA: Alright, well it was nice talking to you.
ParticipantB: Yeah, you too. Have a good day.
